data.title: Rivers and Coastlines
data.passage: Rainwater can fill rivers until water spills over the grassy banks. Similarly, ocean waves can rise high and flood sandy shores. However, a river flood happens much faster after a heavy storm. An ocean flood moves more slowly with the shifting tides. Both events can water the surrounding fields and bring rich soil. Unlike river floods, ocean floods leave behind salty water in the soil.
